deliverables: Enabling onchain payments and card infrastructure
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Stablecoin-backed banking rails and compliance architecture
Open-source payments infrastructure released as a public good
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect on behalf of Wirex/vendor.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ADA, consisting of 3,846,153 ADA for WP1 and a 115,385 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Wirex proposes to deliver full-stack open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement through smart contracts and connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
The proposal says a core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances, enabling users to spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, over 20 billion dollars in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal states that all components will be released as a public good for wallet providers, fintechs, stablecoin issuers, and developers to reuse.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67 percent support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting records, documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

Audit and oversight costs are included in proposal overhead, with independent oversight through Intersect and technically capable third parties, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, and an external Oversight Committee of six entities.
Wirex has not received ADA from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ADA for a Wirex real-world payments initiative, gives a high-level budget and governance custody structure, and relies heavily on asserted adoption and delivery claims while providing external references for the Intersect voting process and treasury smart-contract framework.
